found.quote: You can resources on using AI responsibly in your studies on SurreyLearn, including the following sections:
Providing access to baseline AI tools: We want all students at Surrey to have equal access to AI so you can all engage with tools to support your learning
Surrey’s AI in Education Framework is a progressive approach to AI developed with the Students’ Union.

unsure.quote: This means understanding AI’s limitations and when it is (and isn’t) a useful tool.
unsure.why: Judging usefulness, not tied to learning outcomes.

unsure.quote: The aim is not just to learn how to use AI, but to learn how to judge it critically.
unsure.why: General critical judgement, accuracy not stated.
